concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates project directories that are also written to by other `[P]` tasks (e.g., T002 writes `requirements.txt`, T004 writes `config.py`). Parallel execution could cause race conditions on the filesystem, violating the guarantee that `[P]` tasks have no hidden shared state.

Tasks T078‑T086 (Phase 6) are listed without any explicit linkage to functional requirements (FR‑*) or success criteria (SC‑*). As orphaned tasks they risk missing required deliverables and break the principle that every task should trace to a spec requirement.
